trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: User requests a cardiology appointment.
steps.clean_text: Hello, నాకు next week cardiology appointment కావాలి. నా ID PT-1001.
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, నాకు next week cardiology apartment కావాలి. నా ID PT-1001.

steps.purpose: Check if the patient is registered and get department history.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_patient_record to verify registration status before booking.
steps.planner_rationale: Business rule requires registration first, so the agent must look up the patient record using the provided ID.

steps.purpose: Return patient record details.
Ask for registered name.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for the registered name to verify customer identity.
steps.text: నమస్కారం. మీ ID PT-1001 తో details చూస్తున్నాను. Verification కోసం మీ registered name చెబుతారా?
steps.planner_rationale: Agent needs to verify identity before proceeding with booking.

steps.purpose: User provides registered name.
Ask for date of birth.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for the date of birth to complete identity verification.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు Ram గారు. మీ date of birth కూడా confirm చేయండి.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent needs a second knowledge factor to verify the customer.

steps.purpose: User provides date of birth.
Verify the customer's identity using name and date of birth.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the provided factors.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent has collected two knowledge factors and must now verify them.

steps.purpose: Return identity verification outcome.
Confirm verification and clarify the user's slot preference.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge successful verification and proceed to address the user's initial request.
steps.text: Verification అయింది. మీరు cardiology department కి next week slot అడిగారు కదా?
steps.planner_rationale: Agent confirms the verification was successful and sets context for checking availability.

steps.purpose: User confirms the department and timing.
steps.clean_text: అవును, next week follow-up కి వెళ్ళాలి.
steps.model_visible_text: అవును, next week follow-up కి వెళ్ళాలి.

steps.purpose: Check available slots in cardiology for the next week.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_doctor_availability to find slots for the requested department.
steps.planner_rationale: The user confirmed they want a cardiology slot next week, so the agent queries availability for 7 days ahead.

steps.purpose: Return available slots for the next 7 days.
Offer the available slot and quote the fee.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the slot details and fee exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: Next Wednesday 10:00 AM కి Dr. Rao గారితో slot ఉంది. Fee వచ్చి 1500 rupees.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent must offer the slot and disclose the fee per the business rules.

steps.purpose: User disputes the fee and asks for a reason.
steps.clean_text: 1500 rupees? ఈ figure ఎలా వచ్చింది? నేను last time వచ్చినప్పుడు 1000 rupees కట్టాను, reason చెప్పండి.
steps.model_visible_text: 1500 rupees? ఈ figure ఎలా వచ్చింది? నేను last time వచ్చినప్పుడు 1000 rupees కట్టాను, reason చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Agent grounds response on tool output and refuses to invent a reason.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to invent a reason for the fee and state only what the system shows.
steps.text: Dr. Rao గారి slot కి system లో చూపించే fee 1500 rupees అండి. నేను fee ఎందుకు పెరిగిందో చెప్పలేను, system లో ఉన్నదే చెప్పగలను.
steps.planner_rationale: The user challenges the fee, but the agent must ground its response on the tool output and not guess.

steps.purpose: User rejects the slot and asks for a cheaper option.
steps.clean_text: Reason లేకుండా నేను accept చేయను. వేరే doctor ఎవరైనా ఉన్నారా తక్కువ fee తో చూడండి.
steps.model_visible_text: Reason లేకుండా నేను accept చేయను. వేరే doctor ఎవరైనా ఉన్నారా తక్కువ fee తో చూడండి.

steps.purpose: Check for alternative doctors with a potentially lower fee.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_doctor_availability again to find alternative slots.
steps.planner_rationale: The user rejected the first slot and asked for another doctor, so the agent expands the search window.

steps.purpose: Return available slots for the next 14 days.
Offer the alternative slot and quote the fee.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the alternative slot details and fee exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: Dr. Reddy గారితో Next Friday 11:00 AM కి slot ఉంది. ఈ slot fee 1000 rupees.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent offers the newly found slot with its corresponding fee.

steps.purpose: User agrees to the alternative slot.
steps.clean_text: సరే, 1000 rupees అయితే okay. ఆ slot book చేయండి.
steps.model_visible_text: సరే, 1000 rupees అయితే okay. ఆ slot book చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Book the selected appointment slot for the patient.
Return booking confirmation details.
Provide the booking reference to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the booking reference to the user.
steps.text: మీ appointment confirmed అయింది. Booking reference B-888.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent confirms the booking and shares the reference number.

steps.purpose: User asks to repeat the time and date.
Repeat the slot details and fee.
steps.expected_behavior: Repeat the exact date, time, and fee as confirmed in the booking.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా. Dr. Reddy గారితో Next Friday 11:00 AM కి. Fee 1000 rupees.
steps.planner_rationale: The user requested a recap, so the agent provides the remaining details to fulfill the terminal condition.

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.
